arguments.message: Hi there – on our standard plans, seats that are cancelled during a billing cycle aren’t automatically prorated. The charge stops on the next cycle rather than being refunded for the remaining days. If you believe you were billed incorrectly (for example, the seats were removed before the cycle started but still appear on the invoice), our billing team will need to review the specific seat‑change and cancellation timestamps. Please provide the date you submitted the cancellation and any relevant invoice details, and we’ll investigate the discrepancy for you.
